evidence: Static pairwise read of all 164 criteria (152 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual, 2 gates); 152 functional ids are unique (tomllib parse, weight sum 74.0). No pair grades the same observable and no pair demands incompatible products. Ownership is partitioned explicitly in the descriptions rather than left implicit. Examples checked: (1) validation: functional/judge.toml:29 'Offer inputs and computed overflow have separate owners', :38, :47, :56 split requisition/offer-create/offer-revision/overflow; coordinated numeric validation is a different surface (:1010 'Owns coordinated numeric/overflow validation only'). (2) dates: :74 refusal vs :83 date-only acceptance vs :92 rescission date. (3) relocation exclusion rows (:470, :524, :569, :947) require only payment existence, 'not its exact amount or a sibling arithmetic verdict', so they do not regrade hro_signing/hro_revision_signing/hro_claw. (4) history rows: :443 'Later preservation of old monetary rows belongs to hro_history', :452 'preservation after later revisions belongs to hro_revision_equity', :884 vs :893 approval vs revision ledger, :875 after-image immutability, :1109 batch history. (5) concurrency: :632 two hires vs insufficient budget, :677 'P6/hro_competing separately owns two different hires', sequential stale rows :641/:659/:668 each 'owns sequential ... eligibility only'. (6) anonymous reads: six family confidentiality rows (:704-:749) vs one status-policy row (:758 'an incorrect status alone does not erase proved non-disclosure'); :749 routes coordinated previews/receipts only to hro_anon_read_changes. (7) change-desk vs backend: :1307 'saved-preview content and settlement arithmetic have other owners', :1316 'member-count validation on save belongs to hro_change_shape', :1325 'whether the server refuses malformed numbers belongs to hro_change_numeric', :1334 freshness correctness 'belongs to hro_change_aba and hro_change_noninvalidating and must not be charged here', :1361 'the403 on prepare and commit belongs to the hro_change_prepare and hro_change_commit rows'. (8) cross-dimension: polish/judge.toml:23 'arrival itself belongs to Functional', :50 'not freshness enforcement', :59 'exact duplicate-settlement counts belong to Functional', :41 focus 'not the wording of the explanation or retained entries'; hro_pol_session_resume (ended session, privacy between people) vs functional hro_entries_reload (:1370, workspace switch and reload) are different triggers. (9) visual: visual/judge.toml:84 'do not repeat typography/palette/spacing defects' and visual/prompt.md 'do not deduct the same observed defect in multiple rows by renaming it'. Contradiction probes, all compatible: ordinary same-target concurrent pair must yield exactly one success (:677-:695) while keyed coordinated retries both return the original success (:1055) - different operation families, distinguished in prompt.md:69 'This retry contract differs from ordinary one-off approval/revision/rescission'; extra approval on a touched requisition invalidates a preview (:1028, :1334) while pending creation/unrelated settlement/another preview do not (:1037); all roles read and what-if (:1172, :1361) while non-Finance prepare/commit replay gets 403 (:1181-:1280); unsent entries kept per person (:1370, polish:32) while 'no preview was saved' (:1307, :1361 'the person's own unsent entries are not such records'). Non-blocking residual observations (dependency cascades, not duplicated observables; recorded for the owner, P3 at most): (a) composed-formula chain - one annualisation rounding defect (e.g. truncating 1.7675 to 1.76) changes the figures required by hro_annual, hro_runrate, hro_basis, hro_bands, hro_commitment and hro_desk_figures, although each row grades a different displayed figure/record and :119/:137 try to isolate them; (b) hro_claw's P7 13-month leg (:560, 55.01 claw) uses the Jan-31 clamping start, so a repeated-clamp bug (14 months -> 50% -> claw 50.00) fails both hro_months (:587) and hro_claw; hro_months is protected from rounding defects but hro_claw is not protected from the month defect (hro_cancel is unaffected: 28% of 7 = 1.96 still rounds to 2); (c) hro_change_readers (:1172) largely contains the retrieval observed by hro_change_preview_durable (:992), which adds only the fresh-independent-context requirement; (d) 'alignment' appears in both hro_vis_type and hro_vis_layout anchors. No configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index.json scope), so whether the judge honours these ownership statements in practice is unmeasured; that belongs to rows 38/40, and this row is decided on the criteria text.
